datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data on a monthly basis throughout 2019 across Ethiopia. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML formats) representing food insecurity severity across administrative units, with multiple scenarios and collection dates documented.
